prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1094
Claimant:
Eric Morris
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2024-08-27
Claim reported by the policyholder after a collision at an intersection while turning left across oncoming traffic.
Claimant was the driver of the other vehicle and reports a wrist fracture from the impact.
2024-10-18
Reviewed the policy record and confirmed the policyholder's coverage was in force at the time of loss. Nothing in the
file suggests the vehicle damage predates the coverage start.
2024-11-01
Spoke with the other driver, who described the turn and the impact in the same way as the policyholder. Photos of the
vehicles show damage consistent with the described impact.
2024-11-09
Contacted the police and two independent witnesses. Both witnesses confirm the accident happened as described,
and the responding officer confirmed the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene.
2024-12-02
Claimant was contacted by phone and repeated the same account of the collision that was given at first report. The
account has not changed across any conversation so far.
2024-12-09
Requested the medical records for the wrist injury. Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient
improved, with no complications noted in the records received.
2024-12-10
No prior injury to the wrist or surrounding area is known from the records or from the claimant's statements. Whether
this crash cuased the fracture is still not clear and remains under review.
2025-01-07
Checked the vehicle's prior claim history. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, and the repair estimate lines up
with the new impact only.
2025-02-26
Confirmed that the driver involved lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member under the policy
terms.
2025-03-21
Sent a status request to the medical provider for the final treatment summary. Awaiting response before deciding on
the injury portion of the claim.
2025-03-24
File remains open pending the medical causation review and the final repair invoice. Next contact with the claimant is
scheduled for the coming week.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
